text: Swimming through the sinning like the Angelina Lachnitz. But ain't a fantasy to see as real as it ever was. School ain't for the kids, so they southside a blooded cusp. Wonder what the future could hold if everybody knew what souls are worth more than gold. Come on! Together we can make a change. Together we can work it out. People, we're really the same. Inside and out. We really gotta get it together.
